title: The Assumption Log
short_teaser: Teams often record decisions but not the assumptions behind them.
story: Teams often record decisions but not the assumptions behind them. An assumption log makes it possible to revisit what was believed when the choice was made. A strategy becomes easier to improve when its hidden beliefs are visible. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A strategy becomes easier to improve when its hidden beliefs are visible. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
